visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro band pairing brand copy with a large image
visualCharacteristics.description: Very light lavender band; text column left, angled guideline-pages composite image right | Eyebrow small text, large H2, body paragraph, primary purple button + outlined button | Text column (eyebrow, H2, copy, two buttons) beside a large angled composite image bleeding off the right edge

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 has an eyebrow paragraph, H2, body paragraph and one or more button links; cell 2 has a single image
contentPattern.rationale: Fixed two-part side-by-side layout (text | image) that never wraps into a grid: Columns

usage: Introductory text column (eyebrow, H2, copy, two buttons) beside a large image.
reuseGuidance: Use for a two-part text | image intro band. One row, two cells. Use columns-panel when the text sits in a white panel next to a photo.
